tasks.label: Start Paseo daemon (AtHand)
args: cd paseo-main && npx -y -p node@22 -p npm@10 bash -lc 'set -e; if [[ ! -d node_modules ]]; then npm install --include-workspace-root --ignore-scripts; node scripts/postinstall-patches.mjs; fi; if [[ ! -f packages/relay/dist/e2ee.js ]]; then npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/relay; fi; if [[ ! -d packages/highlight/dist ]]; then npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/highlight; fi; PASEO_HOME=/home/kangkai/AtHand/.paseo-athand PASEO_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:6767 PASEO_RELAY_ENABLED=0 PASEO_DICTATION_ENABLED=0 PASEO_VOICE_MODE_ENABLED=0 PASEO_NODE_INSPECT=0 npm run dev --workspace=@getpaseo/server -- --no-mcp'
